description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ErrorStruct, which manages error records for components of an HTML document, such as tokens, attributes, or CSS properties. It encapsulates error details and hierarchical relationships among different error structures.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorStruct
classes.description: A class representing error structures for segments of an HTML document, capable of holding error details and nested child error structures.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a child ErrorStruct of a specific type and identifier.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error with specified severity and message to the current error structure.
